When she reached the top, she saw a big, beautiful bird. It was so beautiful! She wanted to touch it, but she was too scared.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Bob. Bob was very excited because he was going to the park with his mom. He put on his shoes and ran outside.
When they got to the park, Bob saw a big, red ball. He wanted to play with it, but his mom said, "No, Bob. We can't play with the ball. It's not safe."
Bob was sad, but he listened to his mom. They played with the ball and had lots of fun. After a while, Bob's mom said, "It's time to go home now."

Sue took the ball outside to play. She threw the ball up in the air and tried to catch it. But the ball was too big and heavy. Sue tried again and again, but she could not catch the ball. She felt sad and sat down on the grass.
